hook_text: A cereal box: 1 900 cm² to wrap, 4 200 cm³ to fill. Same box, different questions.
clip_script: A rectangular prism can be filled with layers of unit cubes. The cereal box's base is twenty by seven centimetres, so one layer holds 140 one-centimetre cubes. There are thirty layers, one per centimetre of height. Volume: 140 times thirty, 4 200 cubic centimetres.
visual_style: A cereal box unfolds into a net showing 1 900 cm²; then it refolds and fills with sugar-cube layers stacking to 4 200 cm³.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to turn any box's volume into litres.
